question.instructions: Classify the owner message into exactly one intent: reply, approve, or other.

criteria.reply: The owner asks for an explanation, an answer, or information. The owner wants a reply, not an edit
criteria.approve: The owner approves a proposal, a plan, or the previous agent action. The owner allows the agent to proceed
criteria.other: Anything else that is neither a request for a reply nor an approval

guides.reply: Re: {prompt} — the owner wants an answer, not an edit. Do not edit, write, delete, or commit anything. Investigate only what the answer needs, then answer.
guides.approve: Approved: {prompt} — the owner approved the proposal or previous action. Proceed with the approved change and report the result.

related.instructions: Is the information read in this round trip related to answering the owner message? Answer yes or no.

criteria.yes: The findings in this round help answer the owner message
criteria.no: The findings in this round do not help answer the owner message

answerable.instructions: Can the owner message be answered from the related findings accumulated so far? Answer yes or no.

criteria.yes: The accumulated related findings are enough to answer the owner message
criteria.no: The accumulated related findings are not enough to answer the owner message

stop.nudge: Enough has been investigated to answer. Stop investigating: no new tool calls. Answer the owner from what you have, and name anything you could not confirm.
